tools.name: list_today_tips
tools.description: Returns upcoming informational match tips (pick, confidence, kickoff, page URL) for football or cricket, and renders them as cards in chat. Read-only. Does not place bets, open sportsbooks, show ads, or return affiliate links.

tools.name: get_match_tip
tools.description: Returns one informational tip by match slug, including a short analysis when ready. Read-only. No wagering, ads, or affiliate links.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: Lists leagues that have tip pages on bettingtipsai.com, with hub URLs on that site only. Read-only.

tools.name: list_recent_results
tools.description: Returns recently settled tip outcomes (hit/miss) for track-record questions. Past results do not guarantee future performance. Read-only.
